title: China's Annual Investment in Climate Resilience Infrastructure (2020-2026)
executive_question: How has China's annual investment in climate resilience infrastructure evolved, and what is the projected trajectory through 2026?
required_metrics: Investment category (e.g., water conservancy, urban drainage, geo-hazard monitoring)
comparison_set: Annual investment across categories (water conservancy, urban drainage, geo-hazard monitoring) from 2020 to 2026.
search_queries: China annual investment in water conservancy 2020 2021 2022 2023 2024 2025 2026
China urban drainage infrastructure investment annual data
China geological hazard monitoring investment annual statistics
data_quality_rule: Require at least 4 annual data points from official sources. If only two endpoints are found, use CAGR or government budget forecasts to estimate intermediate values, clearly marking them as estimates.
narrative_role: Establishes the scale and growth trend of China's investment in climate resilience infrastructure, setting the stage for opportunity sizing.
pre_exhibit_context: The report argues that China's 2026 climate disasters have triggered a surge in infrastructure investment. This chart quantifies that surge.
post_exhibit_takeaway: Investment has grown steadily, with a sharp acceleration post-2026 disasters, indicating a robust and expanding market.
